To my knowledge, Mat was tricked into asking the maidens to play Maiden's Kiss with him by Rhuarc, not forced to play, recounting the story to nobles he diced with when he was still in the stone of tear and saying the Maidens he'd played with had "never before heard of a man ''asking ''to play".

There must be more to this game. Mat was kept playing until sunrise, and he left out additional details for the lords find out for themselves if they were foolish enough. Apparently, we are to let our depraved imaginations figure out what else he was doing the whole night. - [[Special:Contributions/71.15.196.237|71.15.196.237]] 02:47, January 29, 2015 (UTC)
